claims.text: Tarciryan was presumably born after the year of the Third Age, the year of his elder brother Tarannon Falastur's birth. In the year , Tarciryan became the father of Eärnil I. In the year , Siriondil, Tarciryan's father, died and his brother Tarannon became the King of Gondor. When Tarannon died without an heir in the year , the throne passed directly to Tarciryan's son, Eärnil I.
